integrity: This is a self-contained proof and reproducible numerical diagnostic; Monte Carlo is not a proof and no independent review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed C^3 strictly convex planar bodies with positive curvature and continuous nonnegative arclength endpoint densities only; no degenerating-shape-uniform error bound. Conditional total variation is established for location and signed normalized gap only; the exact normalized midpoint depth has weak convergence. The older Ehlers-Enns 1981 and Ren 2014 full texts were inaccessible; definitive historical priority and independent validation are not established.
title: Boundary layers of random chord midpoints: a curvature law, marked limit, and optimal sampling
